entries.topic: Which ten items make REVIEW EVIDENCE 10/10 (and whether the statue can be missed)
originals: The ten pieces of evidence?
Which ten items make REVIEW EVIDENCE 10/10: is the flyer one, the backyard,?
Can the statue be missed on a FOUND DEVIANT run?
Can the statue be examined after REVIEW EVIDENCE 10/10, and does the deviant-found?
entries.answer: The transcript prints a REVIEW EVIDENCE n/10 counter under exactly ten interactions: the Carlos reconstruction, knife (2), red ice (3), blood on floor (4), blood on door (5), blood on wall (6), Explore Bathroom (shower rA9 then the statue), knives/missing knife (8), chair (7), bat (9). Read Flyer and Check Backyard have no counter. So the bathroom is evidence, the flyer and backyard are not, and the statue cannot be missed on a FOUND DEVIANT run. PowerPyx lists twelve entries for 'the remaining 9', so it does not decide
entries.source: wiki Partners (Transcript): REVIEW EVIDENCE tabbers under Investigate Knife, Examine Carlos, Examine Drugs, Examine Blood On Floor, Examine Blood On Door, Examine Blood On Wall, Explore Bathroom, Scan Knives, Examine Chair, Scan Bat; none under Read Flyer or Check Backyard
entries.fix: C05h: option 12 (flyer) evidence 1 → none; option 13 (backyard) evidence 1 → none; option 18 (statue) none → evidence 1 (the bathroom counts once, after the statue, as in the transcript tab); keep rules.evidenceNeeded 10 (now all ten required); rewrite the C05h adaptationNote evidence sentence
